data.narrative:
Bellatrix Aerospace is a pre-Series B company in Space & Aerospace that has raised $31M to date. The valuation exercise considers a comp universe of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-stage companies in the sector, including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable to this valuation. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within Space & Aerospace—while 14 same-sector peers exist broadly, none of the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier) yielded the minimum three datapoints required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring cannot proceed because Bellatrix's revenue is not on file; while the Space & Aerospace sector shows a median P/S multiple of 25.3x across the 6 public tickers listed, application of this multiple requires disclosed or estimated target revenue, which is unavailable for private companies.

This analysis is substantially constrained. No quantitative valuation range can be responsibly derived from the available data. Progression toward a defensible estimate would require either: disclosure of Bellatrix's revenue run-rate or forward guidance; identification of at least three pre-Series B or Series A companies with disclosed valuations in Space & Aerospace; or alternative methodologies such as cost-of-capital or scenario-based DCF analysis supported by operational metrics. The current dataset supports only the observation that Bellatrix operates within a high-multiple sector but yields no sufficient basis for valuation synthesis.
